description: Expected results for the official CSDMS HydroTrend default example (repo data/input/HYDRO.IN + HYDRO0.HYPS, 'Greenland Fjord(Mar 2008), 1000 year simulation', start 1908, 1000 years, monthly averaging 'M', 4 grain sizes). inputs/ are the unmodified files from git HEAD of csdms-contrib/hydrotrend (v3.1.4, commit 813a9f1). The Q checks come FROM THE OFFICIAL REFERENCE FILE reference/HYDROASCII.Q (repo data/output/HYDROASCII.Q); the repo's own test is an exact `diff` of this file, so the official tolerance is zero (byte-identical). The QS/QB/LOG checks have no official reference and were recorded from our own runs; two clean runs gave byte-identical output dirs (fixed random seeds, deterministic).
engine_version: HydroTrend 3.0.5 (binary --version) built from csdms-contrib/hydrotrend v3.1.4, commit 813a9f1

numeric_checks.name: Q_sha256_matches_official
numeric_checks.why: official test: run output HYDROASCII.Q must be byte-identical to repo data/output/HYDROASCII.Q (sha256 ebbe5774...)

numeric_checks.name: Q_n_records
numeric_checks.why: official file: 1000 years x 12 monthly averages (HYDRO.IN line 5 averaging = M)

numeric_checks.name: Q_mean_m3s
numeric_checks.why: official file: mean of the monthly river-mouth discharge

numeric_checks.name: Qs_mean_kgs
numeric_checks.why: own run (repeated exactly): mean monthly suspended sediment load, HYDROASCII.QS

numeric_checks.name: Qs_max_kgs
numeric_checks.why: own run (repeated exactly): largest monthly suspended sediment load

numeric_checks.name: Qb_mean_kgs
numeric_checks.why: own run (repeated exactly): mean monthly bedload, HYDROASCII.QB

numeric_checks.name: log_Qbar_m3s
numeric_checks.why: own run: long-term mean daily discharge Qbar printed in HYDRO.LOG

numeric_checks.name: log_Qsbar_kgs
numeric_checks.why: own run: BQART long-term suspended load Qsbar printed in HYDRO.LOG

numeric_checks.name: log_Qpeak_m3s
numeric_checks.why: own run: peak daily discharge Qpeak printed in HYDRO.LOG

numeric_checks.name: log_basin_area_km2
numeric_checks.why: own run: basin area from HYDRO0.HYPS printed in HYDRO.LOG

finished_check: KI tool rc 0, model rc 0, and stdout contains 'HydroTrend 3.0 finished.'
reference: csdms-contrib/hydrotrend data/output/HYDROASCII.Q at commit 813a9f1 (copied unmodified to reference/HYDROASCII.Q); repo test data/hydrotrend_test_with_args.sh.in diffs it exactly
notes: No input tweak. The run is done from inside the temp dir with relative paths 'input' and 'output' because HydroTrend crashes on long absolute output paths (fixed 98/80-char C buffers); this does not change results (output is byte-identical to the official file).
